import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress all output and progress bars
np.random.seed(42)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Check file locations to ensure we're reading correctly
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample sub shape: {sample_sub.shape}")

# Encode labels
print("\nEncoding label column...")
label_enc = LabelEncoder()
y_train_raw = train_df["Cover_Type"].values
train_labels_encoded = label_enc.fit_transform(y_train_raw)

print(f"Label classes: {label_enc.classes_}")

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Cover_Type", "Id"]]
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Fill missing values with median
median_train = X_train_full.median()
median_test = X_test.median()
X_train_full = (
    X_train_full.fillna(median_train.values)
    .fillna(method="ffill")
    .fillna(method="bfill")
)
X_test = X_test.fillna(median_test).fillna(method="ffill").fillna(method="bfill")

# Split WITHOUT stratification due to rare classes
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, train_labels_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

print(f"Train: {len(X_train):,}, Validation: {len(X_val):,}")

# Train TWO models with different random states for ensemble
print("\nTraining ensemble of models...")
model1 = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=-1,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    class_weight="balanced",  # NEW: Handle class imbalance
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    seed=42,
)

model2 = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=-1,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    class_weight="balanced",  # NEW: Handle class imbalance
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    seed=123,
)

model1.fit(X_train, y_train)
model2.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Ensemble prediction via majority vote
y_pred_val = np.argmax(np.stack([model1.predict(X_val), model2.predict(X_val)]), axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
print(f"\nENSEMBLE HOLD-OUT VALIDATION ACCURACY: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
y_test_preds = np.argmax(
    np.stack([model1.predict(X_test), model2.predict(X_test)]), axis=1
)
final_preds = label_enc.inverse_transform(y_test_preds)

# Create submission
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
submission_df["Cover_Type"] = final_preds.astype(int)

# Save to required path
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\nSubmission saved successfully!")
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
